verses.en: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.
verses.pt: Tendo Davi começado a morar em sua casa, disse ao profeta Natã: Eis que eu moro numa casa de cedro, mas a arca do pacto do Senhor está debaixo de cortinas.
verses.en_web: When David lived in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”
verses.en_bbe: Now when David was living in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, See, I am living in a house of cedar-wood, but the ark of the Lord's agreement is under the curtains of a tent.

verses.en: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
verses.pt: Então Natã disse a Davi: Tudo quanto tens no teu coração faze, porque Deus é contigo.
verses.en_web: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
verses.en_bbe: And Nathan said to David, Do whatever is in your heart, for God is with you.

verses.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.pt: Mas sucedeu, na mesma noite, que a palavra de Deus veio à Natã, dizendo:
verses.en_web: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.en_bbe: But that same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.en: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.pt: Vai e dize a Davi, meu servo: Assim diz o Senhor: Tu não me edificarás casa para eu habitar;
verses.en_web: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
verses.en_bbe: Go and say to David my servant, The Lord says, You are not to make me a house for my living-place:

verses.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.pt: porque em nenhuma casa morei, desde o dia em que fiz subir Israel até o dia e hoje, mas fui de tenda em tenda, e de tabernáculo em tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
verses.en_bbe: For from the day when I took Israel up, till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from tent to tent, and from living-place to living-place.

verses.en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.pt: Por todas as partes por onde tenho andado com todo o Israel, porventura falei eu jamais uma palavra a algum dos juízes de Israel, a quem ordenei que apascentasse o meu povo, dizendo: Por que não me tendes edificado uma casa de cedro?
verses.en_web: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
verses.en_bbe: In all the places where I have gone with all Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, whom I made the keepers of my people, Why have you not made for me a house of cedar?

verses.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.pt: Agora, pois, assim dirás a meu servo Davi: Assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos: Eu te tirei do curral, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses chefe do meu povo Israel;
verses.en_web: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So now, say to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people Israel;

verses.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.pt: e estive contigo por onde quer que andavas, e de diante de ti exterminei todos os teus inimigos; também te farei um nome como o nome dos grandes que estão na terra.
verses.en_web: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.

verses.en: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.pt: Designarei um lugar para o meu povo Israel, e o plantarei, para que ele habite no seu lugar, e nunca mais seja perturbado; e nunca mais debilitarão os filhos da perversidade, como dantes,
verses.en_web: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
verses.en_bbe: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be in the place which is theirs and never again be moved; and never again will they be made waste by evil men, as they were at first,

verses.en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
verses.pt: e como desde os dias em que ordenei juízes sobre o meu povo Israel; e subjugarei todos os teus inimigos. Também te declaro que o Senhor te edificará uma casa.
verses.en_web: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.
verses.en_bbe: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will overcome all those who are against you; and I will make you great and the head of a line of kings.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.pt: Quando forem cumpridos os teus dias, para ires a teus pais, levantarei a tua descendência depois de ti, um dos teus filhos, e estabelecerei o seu reino.
verses.en_web: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.en_bbe: And when the time comes for you to go to your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, one of your sons, and I will make his kingdom strong.

verses.en: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.pt: Esse me edificará casa, e eu firmarei o seu trono para sempre.
verses.en_web: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.en_bbe: He will be the builder of my house, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.

verses.en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
verses.pt: Eu lhe serei por pai, e ele me será por filho; e a minha misericórdia não retirarei dele, como a retirei daquele que foi antes de ti;
verses.en_web: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him that was before you;
verses.en_bbe: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son; and I will not take my mercy away from him as I took it from him who was before you;

verses.en: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.pt: mas o confirmarei na minha casa e no meu reino para sempre, e para sempre o seu trono será firme.
verses.en_web: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
verses.en_bbe: But I will make his place in my house and in my kingdom certain for ever; and the seat of his authority will never be overturned.

verses.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.pt: Conforme todas estas palavras, e conforme toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.
verses.en_web: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.en_bbe: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.

verses.en: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.pt: Então entrou o rei Davi, sentou-se perante o Senhor, e disse: Quem sou eu, ó Senhor Deus, e que é a minha casa, para que me tenhas trazido até aqui?,
verses.en_web: Then David the king went in, and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
verses.en_bbe: Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?

verses.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
verses.pt: E isto foi pouco aos teus olhos, O Deus; também falaste da casa do teu servo para tempos distantes, e me consideras como a um homem ilustre, ó Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: This was a small thing in your eyes, God; but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.
verses.en_bbe: And this was only a small thing to you, O God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, looking on me as on one of high position, O Lord God.

verses.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.pt: Que mais te dirá Davi, acerca da honra feita ao teu servo? pois tu bem conheces o teu servo.
verses.en_web: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
verses.en_bbe: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant.

verses.en: O LORD, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.pt: O Senhor! por amor do teu servo, e segundo o teu coração, fizeste todas estas grandezas, tornando conhecidas todas estas grandes coisas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, because of your servant, and from your heart, you have done all these great things and let them be seen.

verses.en: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.pt: O Senhor, ninguém há semelhante a ti, e não há Deus fora de ti, segundo tudo quanto ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, there is no one like you, and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.

verses.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.pt: Também quem há como o teu povo Israel, única gente na terra a quem Deus foi remir para ser seu povo, fazendo-te nome por meio de feitos grandes e terríveis, expulsando as nações de diante do teu povo, que remiste do Egito?
verses.en_web: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeem out of Egypt?
verses.en_bbe: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, making his name great and to be feared, driving out the nations from before your people whom you made free and took out of Egypt?

verses.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
verses.pt: Pois fizeste o teu povo Israel povo teu para sempre; e tu, Senhor, te fizeste seu Deus.
verses.en_web: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
verses.en_bbe: For your people Israel you made yours for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.

verses.en: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.pt: Agora, ó Senhor, seja confirmada para sempre a palavra que falaste acerca da teu servo, e acerca da sua casa, e faze como falaste.
verses.en_web: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
verses.en_bbe: And now, Lord, let your words about your servant and about his family be made certain for ever, and do as you have said.

verses.en: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
verses.pt: E seja o teu nome estabelecido e glorificado para sempre, e diga-se: O Senhor dos exércitos é o Deus de Israel, sim, é Deus para Israel; permaneça firme diante de ti a casa de Davi, teu servo.
verses.en_web: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
verses.en_bbe: So let your words be made certain and your name be made great, when men say, The Lord of armies is the God of Israel; and when the family of David your servant is made strong before you.

verses.en: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
verses.pt: Porque tu, Deus meu, revelaste ao teu servo que lhe edificarias casa; pelo que o teu servo achou confiança para orar em tua presença.
verses.en_web: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
verses.en_bbe: For you, O my God, have let your servant see that you will make him head of a line of kings; and so it has come into your servant's heart to make his prayer to you.

verses.en: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.pt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor, tu és Deus, e falaste este bem acerca do teu servo.
verses.en_web: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.en_bbe: And now, O Lord, you are God, and you have said you will give this good thing to your servant:

verses.en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.pt: E agora foste servido abençoar a casa do teu servo, para que permaneça para sempre diante de ti; porque tu, Senhor, a abençoaste, ficará abençoada para sempre.
verses.en_web: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
verses.en_bbe: And now you have been pleased to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you; you, O Lord, have given your blessing, and a blessing will be on it for ever.
